results.title: One Skip control per displayed exercise of a lifting template (labelled), none on checklist templates; nothing else in the workout screen changes
Skipping records ONLY a flag on the draft session: no work-set, strength, activator, stretch or cardio record is created, and no set is checked
Skip is reversible while the session is a draft
An exercise with logged sets cannot be skipped (nothing is changed, the athlete is told); logging a set on a skipped exercise lifts the skip, so a record always wins
All four execution states in one session: performed, explicitly skipped, partially performed, unmarked gap (skipped, not marked) and not reached; no sets invented
Deliberate skip vs interruption: an explicitly skipped exercise AFTER the last logged one is "skipped", whereas the untouched ones after it are "not reached"
Skipping never makes a session full, never reduces what was prescribed and never fabricates performed sets; skipping everything with no logged work is "none"
Skipping the presented intensifier never credits or advances the Giant B rotation, and logs no intensifier record
A skip survives a reload and resume, and a backup round trip
Validator: skips must be {slot index: true} for slots that exist; anything else is refused with a specific message
A finished session cannot be re-skipped, and the Finish preview and notice name explicit skips as "skipped" (not "not reached")
